senses.en_definition: An island; an area of land completely surrounded by water.

messages.en: Which island should we go to for the next holiday? I really feel like going to Tioman.
Me too! But how many nights do you want to stay? That'll help me work out my budget.
Maybe two nights for now. We can check room rates together later.
How much longer do we have to wait?
Just twenty minutes. Then we'll head off.

senses.en_definition: Also; too; used to include someone or something in what has already been said.
Used with indefinite expressions to mean any or every, regardless of what or who.
Even; used to emphasize an extreme case, including the smallest amount or number in negative statements.
Even if; although; used to show that something holds or happens despite a condition or obstacle.

collocations.en: buy it even if it's expensive
keep trying even when it's difficult

messages.en: Mira and I are going to grab a bite at the place downstairs. Have you eaten yet?
Not yet. I want to come along too! Wait a sec for me, okay?
Let's go. We'll wait for you by the lift.
My butt's aching from sitting here for so long.
Let's get up and walk around for a bit, then get back to work.
